name: Walmart
description: Walmart is the world's largest retailer, selling groceries, general merchandise and health products in 10,900+ stores and clubs serving about 280 million customers a week, plus online. Most profit comes from thin margins on huge volume, mainly the US stores. Walmart also runs Sam's Club (membership warehouse clubs), international operations including majority stakes in Flipkart and PhonePe in India, and growing high-margin side businesses: advertising to suppliers (Walmart Connect, nearly $6.4B in FY2026) and membership fees ($6.75B of 'membership and other income'). eCommerce is growing fastest, led by store-fulfilled pickup and delivery.
